```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

# Load Data

```{r load data}

ffq <- read_csv(here("Data", "Raw", "Metadata", "df_ffq_cleaned.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(sample_id = gsub("-","_",record_id)) %>%
  select(-(2:29)) %>%
  mutate(across(-sample_id, ~ replace_na(.x, 1))) %>%
  select(-hbitos_de_alimentacin_y_frecuencia_de_consumo_ffq_complete, -record_id)

metadata <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "metadata.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

common_samples <- intersect(metadata$sample_id, ffq$sample_id)
diff_samples1 <- setdiff(metadata$sample_id, ffq$sample_id)
diff_samples2 <- setdiff(ffq$sample_id, metadata$sample_id)
cat("Common samples in metadata and ffq tables:\n", common_samples)

cat("\nSamples in metadata but not in ffq tables:\n", diff_samples1)

cat("\nSamples in ffq tables but not in metadata:\n", diff_samples2)

ffq <- ffq %>% filter(sample_id %in% common_samples)

```

```{r dict check}
missing_from_dictionary <- setdiff(colnames(ffq), names(food_name_map))
extra_in_dictionary <- setdiff(names(food_name_map), colnames(ffq))

missing_from_dictionary
extra_in_dictionary

```
# Rename columns

```{r rename}
ffq_english <- ffq %>% rename_with(
    .fn = ~ recode(.x, !!!food_name_map),
    .cols = everything()) %>%
  relocate(sample_id)
```


# Save
```{r save}
write_tsv(ffq_english, here("Data", "Processed", "ffq_english.tsv"))

# Spanish FFQ code <-> English food name, used to join external classifications
write_tsv(enframe(food_name_map, name = "code", value = "food") %>% filter(code != "sample_id"),
          here("Data", "Processed", "ffq_dictionary.tsv"))
```
